events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, known as Liam Gallagher, was born on September 21, 1972, and is an English vocalist and songwriter who gained fame as the lead singer of Oasis.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: The iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today. Still rocking, still cool.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, and the album of the same name was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: Apple's first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket,' which revolutionised portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the first iPod, changing how we listened to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy who's been thrilling us for decades.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, the legendary John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. A true comedic genius.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album.' A sprawling masterpiece that proved their incredible versatility.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead vocalist of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true icon. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their pivotal sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul,' on December 3, 1965, in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul,' an album that marked a significant evolution in their sound. A true classic.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, outside his New York City residence.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years after his tragic passing. His legacy of music, peace, and love continues to resonate worldwide.
